policy: Public release builds require VERIFY_STORE_POLICY=1 and an approved store policy record.

appListing.subtitle: Quiet intelligence, close at hand.
appListing.fullDescription: Solin is an experimental, privacy-first phone-side AI assistant for Android. Downloaded or imported models run locally; verified local vision models can process user-provided images on device. User-configured remote multimodal models require an explicit remote path. Ordinary remote chat text follows the selected reminder policy; image attachments and suspected sensitive chat content require per-send confirmation. Optional remote-vision phone control separately requires opt-in and a first in-app confirmation before screen egress. Reversible phone actions can run under critical-only confirmation; sensitive external sends and private-derived outgoing content require confirmation. The agent never taps pay, send, delete, publish, order, transfer, or authorize controls: the user taps them. Chats, explicit memories, models and audit records stay local by default. Device compatibility and release reviews remain incomplete.

zh-CN.subtitle: 让 AI 住在手机里
zh-CN.shortDescription: 让 AI 住在手机里
zh-CN.fullDescription: 栖知 Solin 是实验性的隐私优先 Android 助手：下载或导入的模型在本地运行，已验证的本地视觉模型可处理用户提供的图片。用户配置远程模型并明确选择远程路径后才使用远程推理。普通远程聊天文本遵循提醒策略；图片附件和疑似敏感聊天内容逐次确认。可选远程视觉手机操作另需主动启用，并在首次应用内步骤确认后才外发屏幕内容。默认只确认关键步骤，可逆操作可连续执行，敏感外发和私有读取衍生的外发内容仍需确认。支付、发送、删除、发布、下单、转账和授权控件始终由用户亲自点击。聊天、显式记忆、模型和审计记录默认保存在设备上；设备兼容性与发布审查尚未完成。

en-US.subtitle: Quiet intelligence, close at hand.
en-US.fullDescription: Solin is an experimental, privacy-first Android assistant with local chat, optional remote models, local memory and bounded phone tools. Reversible steps can run under critical-only confirmation; sensitive external actions require confirmation, and critical controls remain user-tapped. Remote screen use requires its own opt-in and first in-app confirmation. Device compatibility and release reviews remain incomplete.

externalRecipients: Recommended and custom model download hosts
Android system or destination apps opened by external intents permitted under the configured confirmation policy

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.purpose: Connects for explicitly eligible remote model/vision calls, optional decision routing, user-requested web search and model downloads; debug background control uses authenticated local loopback transport.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
permissions.purpose: Lets the user dictate text through explicit voice input before sending.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_CALENDAR
permissions.purpose: Reads busy/free calendar windows for user-requested tools after Android permission and the configured action policy; critical-only mode can auto-approve eligible read-only steps.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_CONTACTS
permissions.purpose: Looks up contact names or phone matches for user-requested tools after Android permission and the configured action policy; results remain local evidence.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.purpose: Supports media or file metadata reads on Android 12L/API 32 and below under Android permission and the configured action policy.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES
permissions.purpose: Reads recent image metadata or user-selected images under Android grants and tool policy; local OCR and remote image sends have separate consent boundaries.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO
permissions.purpose: Supports user-provided video attachments and recent media metadata checks under Android grants and tool policy; video bytes are not automatically uploaded or transcribed.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED
permissions.purpose: Honors Android selected visual media grants for user-chosen image inputs.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO
permissions.purpose: Handles user-provided audio attachments as metadata-only inputs without automatic upload.

permissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.purpose: Posts reminder notifications only for user-created or confirmed background tasks.

permissions.name: com.android.alarm.permission.SET_ALARM
permissions.purpose: Opens Android's system alarm or timer flow for user-requested actions permitted under the configured confirmation policy.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
permissions.purpose: Runs a short-lived foreground device-control session for user-requested Accessibility actions permitted by the configured confirmation policy.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE
permissions.purpose: Declares the special-use foreground service type for user-requested device-control sessions under the configured confirmation policy.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION
permissions.purpose: Runs one-shot current-screen OCR capture only after the Android MediaProjection foreground consent flow.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
permissions.purpose: Restores scheduled reminder alarms after device reboot or app replacement.

permissions.name: android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS
permissions.purpose: Estimates the foreground app for user-requested device-context tools when Usage Access is granted, subject to the configured action policy.

specialAccessDisclosures.name: UsageAccess
specialAccessDisclosures.purpose: Estimates the current foreground app after the user grants Usage Access; each request still follows the configured action policy.

specialAccessDisclosures.name: AccessibilityService
specialAccessDisclosures.purpose: Enabled explicitly in Android settings for local screen reads and user-initiated bounded phone actions under the configured confirmation policy. Critical controls remain user-tapped. Optional remote-vision control uses Accessibility screenshots only after opt-in and the first in-app confirmation; experimental debug background displays are not a store-ready capability.

specialAccessDisclosures.name: MediaProjection
specialAccessDisclosures.purpose: Used only after foreground consent for one-shot current screenshot OCR.
